fields.climate: tropical marine, mild; little seasonal temperature variation
fields.terrain: mostly mountains with coastal plain in north; precipitous mountains to the sea on west coast; sandy beaches along most coastal areas
fields.resources: some copper and nickel; potential for onshore and offshore oil
fields.farm: milk, plantains, bananas, tomatoes, chicken, oranges, mangoes/guavas, pineapples, eggs, pumpkins/squash
fields.exports: packaged medicines, medical cultures/vaccines, hormones, orthopedic and medical appliances, sulfur compounds
fields.industries: pharmaceuticals, electronics, apparel, food products, tourism
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 56%, Protestant 33% (largely Pentecostal), other 2%, atheist 1%, none 7%

system.text: unincorporated organized territory of the US with local self-government…

fields.legal: civil law system based on the Spanish civil code, within the framework of the US federal system
